summary: Publish the CLI actor syntax as a generated, versioned contract and report effective instance and state directory on request.

rules.detail: No authority rule or command behavior change.

compatibility.detail: Adds st actor-contract --json and optional --effective output. Existing CLI commands, wire APIs and actor defaults are unchanged. The new syntax contract does not grant person authority.

manual.detail: Operators may read the new contract instead of maintaining a command list. Operator policy and authority checks remain in place.
